theorem lg_target (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : x + y = 2) : x * y ≤ 1 := by
  have h_sum : x + y = 2 := h
  have h_non_neg : 0 ≤ x ∧ 0 ≤ y := hx ∧ hy
  have h_am_gm : (x + y) / 2 ≥ √(x * y) := by apply real.am_gm; exact h_non_neg
  have h_ineq : 1 ≥ √(x * y) := by rw [h_sum]; rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; exact h_am_gm
  have h_square : 1 ≥ x * y := by rwa [pow_two, sqrt_le]
  exact h_square
